verdict.rationale: Evidence shows replying to customers is possible via the MCP/LLM integration ('reply to customers' listed as a workflow action in canny-docs-5), implying reply functionality exists tied to feedback records, but there's no direct documentation of the native in-app 'reply from feedback record' UI workflow that PMs would typically use day-to-day. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the standard in-product reply/comment feature on a feedback post, screenshots or UI walkthrough, and independent/hands-on confirmation that replies close the loop with customers via email/notification.
